actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && rfkill unblock bluetooth || rfkill block bluetooth'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'rfkill list bluetooth | grep -q "Soft blocked: no" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'region=$(slurp) && [ -n "$region" ] && grim -g "$region" - | wl-copy && notify-send "Screenshot" "Copied to clipboard"'
sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && pactl set-sink-port @DEFAULT_SINK@ analog-output-headphones || pactl set-sink-port @DEFAULT_SINK@ analog-output-speaker'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pactl list sinks | grep -q "Active Port: analog-output-headphones" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && pactl set-source-port @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ analog-input-headset-mic || pactl set-source-port @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ analog-input-internal-mic'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pactl list sources | grep -q "Active Port: analog-input-headset-mic" && echo true || echo false'
